# picohttpparser

Upstream: https://github.com/h2o/picohttpparser
Pinned revision: dd573d8fa9264c646a400e96ce9f07dea6f156e4

Unmodified picohttpparser.c and picohttpparser.h. MIT license text and upstream copyright are embedded in both source files. The HTTP parser is third-party code; the DB engine, queue/thread pool, framing limits and API handling are this project's implementation.
